title: LRU cache (capacity 3) as a linked list

ops.caption: get a: miss — insert a at the head (head = most recently used)
get b: miss — insert b at the head
get c: miss — insert c at the head; the cache is now full (capacity 3)
get a: hit — remove a from its current spot
move a to the head: this remove + reinsert-at-0 is what "move to front" means
get d: miss — b is at the tail, the eviction candidate: evict it
